unit_cost_basis: One existing shared semantic-operation debit per reached proposed bounded unit; O uses original schedule. All added groupings explicitly proposed.

units.name: binding claim
units.body: One named native lookup or membership/absence claim in already justified passive storage, followed by one pinned identity or declared presence/absence test. Fixed native namespace access for that binding is included. No entry traversal or copy.
units.multiplicity: Each actual class/module/instance/global/builtin lookup or named-key membership/absence check, including attribute-only co_names. Global and builtin lookups are distinct; repeats pay again.
units.payment: Immediately before bounded body; A is the charge itself; O retains existing source charge positions
units.failed_charge: Stop request before body; retain actual reach/construction counter order and exception

units.name: raw read
units.body: One native field, slot, sequence entry or context-state read, without a value predicate.
units.multiplicity: Each actual read outside B/G bodies; repeated reads repeat payment.
units.payment: Immediately before bounded body; A is the charge itself; O retains existing source charge positions
units.failed_charge: Stop request before body; retain actual reach/construction counter order and exception

units.name: scalar or shape test
units.body: One identity, exact-type, bounded native scalar/string value-equality, sign, scalar-bound or container-length predicate over already available native values. Exact native types and manifest size bounds required; no arbitrary user equality.
units.multiplicity: Each reached predicate, including native keyword-name equality and source short-circuit tests. A conjunction is several predicates.
units.payment: Immediately before bounded body; A is the charge itself; O retains existing source charge positions
units.failed_charge: Stop request before body; retain actual reach/construction counter order and exception

units.name: current equality claim
units.body: Compare current native numerator/denominator pairs using at most two native integer equalities, preserving source short-circuit order.
units.multiplicity: Every attempted fresh pair claim, including declines and rechecks.
units.payment: Immediately before bounded body; A is the charge itself; O retains existing source charge positions
units.failed_charge: Stop request before body; retain actual reach/construction counter order and exception

units.name: native query
units.body: One pinned native trace/profile query or optional integer bit-length query.
units.multiplicity: Each reached query; original guard widths are in G.
units.payment: Immediately before bounded body; A is the charge itself; O retains existing source charge positions
units.failed_charge: Stop request before body; retain actual reach/construction counter order and exception

units.name: traversal step
units.body: One native iterator creation OR one advance, including a reached exhausted advance and fixed iterator-internal cursor/pair bookkeeping. No entry predicates or explicitly materialized retained record/copy.
units.multiplicity: Each reached creation/advance separately, even on rejected paths.
units.payment: Immediately before bounded body; A is the charge itself; O retains existing source charge positions
units.failed_charge: Stop request before body; retain actual reach/construction counter order and exception

units.name: bounded record creation
units.body: Allocate one empty proof/context/manifest record of a predeclared bounded shape.
units.multiplicity: Each actual record; population uses W.
units.payment: Immediately before bounded body; A is the charge itself; O retains existing source charge positions
units.failed_charge: Stop request before body; retain actual reach/construction counter order and exception

units.name: record occurrence
units.body: Store/copy one bounded reference, native scalar or flag into one declared proof/context/manifest slot.
units.multiplicity: Each actual written proof/context/manifest occurrence, including repeated copies. A conditional uniqueness-table insertion included in D is not also W. Source/Agent/GLB logical-entry regimes unchanged.
units.payment: Immediately before bounded body; A is the charge itself; O retains existing source charge positions
units.failed_charge: Stop request before body; retain actual reach/construction counter order and exception

units.name: deduplication entry
units.body: One bounded native lookup and conditional insertion for one incoming exact-string or original native-function identity key in a preparation-only uniqueness table. The conditional table insertion is included; no whole-table scan or output copy.
units.multiplicity: One per input key including duplicates. Empty table uses C; later output container/entries use C/W. Existing table is bounded by exact manifest.
units.failed_charge: Stop before this key attempt; preserve actual meter partial execution and earlier completed preparation.

units.name: original guard stage on proof route
units.body: One original operand-width stage (four original widths and guard) OR prospective stage (two original width sums and guard), with original meaning/order.
units.multiplicity: Each reached stage on proof route. Ordinary compare keeps its existing composite O; physically repeated fallback guards are separate original work.
units.authority: proposed allocation of retained guard work on replacement route
units.payment: Immediately before bounded body; A is the charge itself; O retains existing source charge positions
units.failed_charge: Stop request before body; retain actual reach/construction counter order and exception

units.name: first admission charge
units.body: The existing independent_certificate_compare_admission charge event. Does not include subsequent admitted flag write or any preceding proof.
units.multiplicity: Reached only while unadmitted; native successful increment only when actual charge reaches increment. No additional wrapper charge.
units.authority: retained source event, newly explicit limited funding
units.payment: The existing charge event itself; no added precharge wrapper.
units.failed_charge: A is the existing charge event itself: retain actual partial meter execution and counter/exception order. No admitted-state write follows a failure.

units.name: original operation
units.body: Original group/decode/comparison/threshold/caller operation with its existing accounting, dispatch and guards.
units.multiplicity: Original source schedule; no added wrapper charge. Already-native ordinary comparison has one comparison tick.
units.payment: Original source execution and charge positions; no added precharge wrapper.
units.failed_charge: Retain original execution and stopping point, including guards or decodes already performed before a later comparison charge refuses. No claim that the whole O body was unperformed.

partition_rules: B includes its one named lookup and identity test; do not also charge R/T for the same occurrence.
G includes original width reads/sums/guard on proof route; do not also charge N for those same widths.
Original ordinary comparator includes its own guards in O; separately repeated optional/fallback occurrences remain separately accounted.
I prices creation/advance including reached exhaustion; entry predicates/copies have separate units.
C creates bounded record; W populates each actual slot. Helper records do not silently become source/JSON/GLB logical values.
Meter administrative implementation follows existing primitive; new authentication/instrumentation is not exempt.
No complete-gate composite, retrospective payment, refunds, per-bytecode rule or cross-group amortization.
B expressly includes named-key membership/presence/absence; T includes bounded exact-native string equality.
D includes its conditional uniqueness-table insertion; do not also charge W for that insertion. The empty uniqueness table and later output copies remain C/W.
Source-created early proof tuples and reached (kwdefaults or {}) dictionaries are C/W as applicable; fixed iterator-internal bookkeeping is included in I.
Only added units promise charge-before-body. A is the existing event; O may have executed original guard/decode work before its charge refuses.
